title: Atomically create a native event batch — docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md#t1
acceptance: Read the approved gates in docs/plans/ics-import/ and execute only packet T1 in docs/plans/ics-import/04-task-slices.md.
Outcome: `EventService` can create multiple ordinary or recurring native events and their occurrence exceptions as one authorized, audited transaction.

Changes: Add the approved `EventCreateBatch`, item, exception, recurrence-key, and result types; implement `EventService::create_batch`; reuse existing event validation, recurrence validation, authorization, audit, CalDAV change, and notification-replanner helpers; add focused service tests for atomic rollback, exception persistence, side-effect counts, and native editability.
Out of scope: ICS parsing or UID grouping, HTTP routes, parser error mapping, rate-limit classification, frontend work.

Acceptance: A valid mixed batch commits all top-level events and exceptions; invalid input or a database failure commits none; authorization is checked as `CreateEvent`; every top-level row has one create audit and CalDAV change; imported-style rows have no external mapping and remain editable; notification replanning occurs only after commit.

Handoff: Stable batch input/result types and proven transactional semantics for the ICS coordinator; record exact type names if implementation-required Rust adjustments preserve the approved meanings.
Record verification and completion in docs/plans/ics-import/00-status.md; preserve unrelated work.
